name: Bench2Drive-Full
description: A benchmark suite aimed at evaluating autonomous driving perception and related driving tasks using recorded sensor data. It provides annotated scenes and labels for multiple driving-related tasks to assess model performance across detection, segmentation and prediction. Designed to support end-to-end and modular driving systems in realistic driving conditions.
reputation: A specialized benchmark maintained by RethinkLab with limited but growing use in driving research; not as widely referenced as larger public driving benchmarks.
